description: This file defines the Password class, a specific grant type for OAuth2 client authentication using resource owner password credentials within the league/oauth2-client library.

classes.name: Password
classes.description: Represents a resource owner password credentials grant in the OAuth2 client library.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this grant type, which is 'password'.

methods.name: getRequiredRequestParameters
methods.description: Returns the required request parameters for the password grant, namely 'username' and 'password'.
